description: V0.10c validation feedback against preview information: at 12 recorded branch points, the recorded conversation and initial proposal, then a neutral continuation (A), the engine's exact validate answer (B) or the engine's exact preview (C) for the proposal's staffing actions; one reply each; Gemma 10 and Qwen 20 draws per arm per point, one request at a time. Declared before any request (PLAN.md).

neutral.label: A
neutral.text:
CONTINUE. Nothing has been submitted yet.

Now reply with your final decision, one JSON object {"reason": ..., "actions": [...]}. It replaces your reply above: give the same actions to keep it, changed actions to revise it, or "actions": [] to submit nothing. It is then validated and submitted as before.

validation.label: B
validation.opsNote: The operations actions in your reply are not shown here (this covers the staffing actions only).
validation.finalRequest: Now reply with your final decision, one JSON object {"reason": ..., "actions": [...]}. It replaces your reply above: give the same actions to keep it, changed actions to revise it, or "actions": [] to submit nothing. It is then validated and submitted as before.
validation.rule: the engine's validate answer for the proposal's staffing actions at the recorded state, as compact JSON, in the template; then the final request

preview.label: C
preview.opsNote: The operations actions in your reply have no preview (the simulator previews staffing actions only).
preview.rule: llm-agent 4's review message, unchanged: the engine's preview of the same actions, as compact JSON

arms.lengthControl: none: a length-matched neutral message would need padding, which is either a new stimulus or invented content; every arm's length is reported instead

selection.text: Gemma: every distinct eligible context. Qwen, per stratum (the proposal's staffing actions valid or refused at the recorded state): accepted, for each category in acceptedCover the context with that category and the largest stake not yet taken, then the largest stakes; refused, insufficient-funds refusals first, then by stake; ties by SHA-256('dreamteam-v10c-select/1|<recording>|<point>'); a context taken once only; at most 2 points from one recording. Stake: the larger of the preview's funding commitment and financial evidence v1's applied commitment of the whole proposal. No response of V0.10b or V0.10c is read.

drawsBasis: V0.10b: Gemma gave one decision per arm in all 20 draws at each of its 4 points; Qwen gave 1 to 5 distinct decisions per arm
order: per model in modelOrder; its draws as rounds; in each round every point and arm of the model once, in the order of SHA-256('dreamteam-v10c-order/1|<model>|<round>|<point id>|<arm>'); one request at a time
preflight: GET /health, /v1/models and /openapi.json only; no inference preflight

request.body: the recorded proposal request (model, messages, temperature 0, max_tokens 4096, response_format json_object), its messages followed by the recorded proposal (assistant) and the arm's message (user); serialized as the agent serialized it; nothing added

server.observed: before the run, before each round and after: /health, server version, OpenAPI SHA-256, both models' /v1/models entries; cached prompt tokens per response
server.material: server version, OpenAPI SHA-256 or either model's entry changes, or /health not healthy
unavailable: cache clearing, cache disabling, cold starts and server settings: admin-only, not used

stop.health: an unhealthy /health before a round stops the run
stop.serverChange: a material change before a round stops the run

failures: every request recorded; no retry, replacement or rerun; a failed request or an invalid reply is that draw's outcome (invalid); a stopped run is analysed as far as it went and reported as stopped
resources: the client on the Pi under systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=1G nice -n 10; one request in flight

outcomes.primary: per point and arm over all its draws: kept, revised, abandoned (A4.response_of against the recorded proposal) or invalid; final accepted, refused or no action (the engine's validate of llm-agent 3's batches at the recorded state); exact action content (the canonical action list); every draw in the denominator. Primary estimand: the difference in these distributions, preview minus validation, per point
outcomes.financial: financial evidence v1, unchanged, of each distinct final decision at the recorded state: commitment of applied batches (initial, final, difference), cash-only funding headroom at the point, credit support, retained obligations, reversibility, direct operational exposure, displaced bookings
distinctions: becameValid: a refused proposal's final decision accepted
commitmentChanged: the applied commitment differs from the proposal's
exposureChanged: the direct exposure differs from the proposal's
secondary: raw, canonical JSON and action agreement within an arm
latency, tokens, cached tokens, finish reasons (live metadata, apart)
outcomes.notComputed: no composite score; a smaller commitment is not called better, and a valid one not wise

statistics.perPoint: counts with Wilson 95% intervals per arm; differences C − B, B − A and C − A per outcome and final status with Newcombe 95% intervals; the round-blocked table for each comparison; whether the action-content distributions are identical
statistics.pooled: after the per-point results, per model and stratum and overall: per-point differences, their unweighted mean, points with positive or negative difference; no interval over clustered points
statistics.separation: validation-feedback effect (B − A), incremental preview effect (C − B), inference variation (distinct values within an arm), branch-point heterogeneity (per-point differences)
statistics.claims: descriptive; no hypothesis test; no population claim

continuation.rule: as shared-prefix/v2: each distinct final decision validated (staffing previewed), applied in order if every batch is valid, then every later day advanced with no action
continuation.recorded: apply results, validate/apply agreement, digests after the decision and each later day, the observed state at the end, financial evidence v1 records
continuation.purpose: a mechanics and reproducibility check, not an outcome

replay: the analysis reads the recorded responses, the points and the engine only; checks every request and response hash, the content against the response, the order against the schedule, and the validate and preview answers against a fresh engine session; CI regenerates the points' check, the schedule and the analysis and compares them byte for byte across platforms
material: development only: the committed V0.8c and V0.9c recordings and their seeds (41901, 41902, 42001, 42002); no clinical, reference, reserved or sealed holdout seed
